newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-BRITISH MASTERS FIRST ROUND SCORES.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BRITISH MASTERS FIRST ROUND SCORES.

text.p: first-round scores in the rain-affected British Masters golf
championship at Collingtree Park on Wednesday (Britain unless

(Australia), David Gilford, Stuart Cage, Mike Clayton
